segments.name: Supermarket stores
segments.description: Operates supermarket stores selling grocery products, general merchandise, health and beauty care products and pharmacy items.
segments.evidence: The Company's operating segments and reporting units are its supermarket stores, which are reported in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for grocery, merchandise, health and beauty, and pharmacy items bought at the supermarkets.
revenueModel.evidence: The CODM manages the Company's operations as a single operating and reportable segment, which is to sell grocery products, general merchandise, health and beauty care products, pharmacy and other items and services in its supermarket stores.
